items.title: Dover (DOV) Completes Leistung Acquisition To Deepen Clean Energy Push
items.summary: Dover (NYSE:DOV) has completed the acquisition of Leistung Engineering Pvt. Ltd., adding to its Clean Energy & Fueling segment. Leistung Engineering supplies components and systems used in clean energy and fueling applications, broadening Dover's technology and product base. The acquired business will be integrated into Dover's existing clean energy portfolio, expanding its reach across fueling infrastructure markets.
